yb: YB is a soft silvery metallic element.
YB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1000 zettabits or 10^24 bits.
YB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1000 zettabytes or 10^24 bytes.
YB means the same as ytterbium or atomic number 70 or yottabit.
ybit: Ybit is a unit of information equal to 1000 zettabits or 10^24 bits.
Ybit means the same as yottabit or Yb.
